reference_sql:
WITH tv_orders AS (
  -- one row per 2025 order with a TV line
  SELECT ol.order_id,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(ol.promo_id) > 0 THEN 'promoted' ELSE 'regular' END AS tv_offer
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name IN ('TVs up to 43 inch', 'TVs 50-55 inch', 'TVs 65 inch and up')
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id
),
flagged AS (
  -- one row per TV order, with 1 when the same order holds a soundbar line
  SELECT t.order_id, t.tv_offer,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM order_lines AS sl
           JOIN products AS sp ON sp.product_id = sl.product_id
           JOIN categories AS sc ON sc.category_id = sp.category_id
           WHERE sl.order_id = t.order_id
             AND sc.category_name = 'Soundbars'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_soundbar
  FROM tv_orders AS t
)
SELECT tv_offer,
       COUNT(*) AS n_tv_orders,
       SUM(has_soundbar) AS n_with_soundbar,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*), 2) AS attach_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*))
             / (SELECT 1.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*) FROM flagged), 1) AS attach_index
FROM flagged
GROUP BY tv_offer
ORDER BY tv_offer

WITH tv_orders AS (
  -- one row per 2025 order with a TV line
  SELECT ol.order_id,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(ol.promo_id) > 0 THEN 'promoted' ELSE 'regular' END AS tv_offer
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name IN ('TVs up to 43 inch', 'TVs 50-55 inch', 'TVs 65 inch and up')
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id
),
soundbar_orders AS (
  -- one row per order with a soundbar line
  SELECT DISTINCT sl.order_id
  FROM order_lines AS sl
  JOIN products AS sp ON sp.product_id = sl.product_id
  JOIN categories AS sc ON sc.category_id = sp.category_id
  WHERE sc.category_name = 'Soundbars'
),
flagged AS (
  -- one row per TV order, with 1 when it is also a soundbar order
  SELECT t.order_id, t.tv_offer,
         CASE WHEN so.order_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_soundbar
  FROM tv_orders AS t
  LEFT JOIN soundbar_orders AS so ON so.order_id = t.order_id
),
overall AS (
  -- one row: the attach rate of all TV orders
  SELECT 1.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*) AS attach_rate
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT f.tv_offer,
       COUNT(*) AS n_tv_orders,
       SUM(f.has_soundbar) AS n_with_soundbar,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.has_soundbar) / COUNT(*), 2) AS attach_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 * SUM(f.has_soundbar) / COUNT(*)) / MAX(ov.attach_rate), 1) AS attach_index
FROM flagged AS f
CROSS JOIN overall AS ov
GROUP BY f.tv_offer
ORDER BY f.tv_offer

  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM categories WHERE category_name LIKE 'TVs %')
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id
),

  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN promoted = 1 THEN 'promoted' ELSE 'regular' END AS tv_offer,
         CASE WHEN order_id IN (
           SELECT sl.order_id
           FROM order_lines AS sl
           JOIN products AS sp ON sp.product_id = sl.product_id
           JOIN categories AS sc ON sc.category_id = sp.category_id
           WHERE sc.category_name = 'Soundbars'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_soundbar
  FROM tv_orders
)
SELECT tv_offer,
       COUNT(*) AS n_tv_orders,
       SUM(has_soundbar) AS n_with_soundbar,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*), 2) AS attach_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*)
             / (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(has_soundbar) / COUNT(*) FROM flagged) * 100, 1) AS attach_index

WITH tv_orders AS (
  -- one row per 2025 order with a TV line
  SELECT ol.order_id,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(ol.promo_id) > 0 THEN 'promoted' ELSE 'regular' END AS tv_offer
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN sales AS s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  WHERE s.category_name IN ('TVs up to 43 inch', 'TVs 50-55 inch', 'TVs 65 inch and up')
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id
),
flagged AS (
  -- one row per TV order, with 1 when the same order holds a soundbar line
  SELECT t.tv_offer,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM sales AS sb
           WHERE sb.order_id = t.order_id AND sb.category_name = 'Soundbars'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_soundbar
  FROM tv_orders AS t
)
SELECT tv_offer,
       COUNT(*) AS n_tv_orders,
       SUM(has_soundbar) AS n_with_soundbar,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_soundbar), 2) AS attach_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_soundbar) / (SELECT AVG(has_soundbar) FROM flagged), 1) AS attach_index
FROM flagged
GROUP BY tv_offer
ORDER BY tv_offer

solver.query:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT order_id FROM orders
  WHERE CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND CAST(order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
t AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoted
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name IN ('TVs up to 43 inch', 'TVs 50-55 inch', 'TVs 65 inch and up')
  GROUP BY ol.order_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ol.order_id
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name = 'Soundbars'
),
k AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN t.promoted = 1 THEN 'promoted' ELSE 'regular' END AS tv_offer,
         COUNT(*) AS n_tv_orders,
         COUNT(s.order_id) AS n_with_soundbar
  FROM t LEFT JOIN s ON s.order_id = t.order_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT tv_offer, n_tv_orders, n_with_soundbar,
       ROUND(100.0 * n_with_soundbar / n_tv_orders, 2) AS attach_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 * n_with_soundbar / n_tv_orders) / (1.0 * (SELECT SUM(n_with_soundbar) FROM k) / (SELECT SUM(n_tv_orders) FROM k)), 1) AS attach_index
FROM k
ORDER BY tv_offer
